words.button: Hilal is showing the stars tonight

stars.line: It never moves. Find it and you know where north is, every night of your life.

stars.en: the seven stars of the Bier
stars.line: They wheel round the Pole Star like daughters round a bier. Follow their edge and they point to al-Jady.
A little cluster, like a bunch of grapes. When it rises before dawn, the farmers know the hot season is coming.
Low in the south. When Suhayl rises, the worst of the summer heat is over.
The brightest star in the night. It is named in the Quran: He is the Lord of ash-Shi'ra.
The follower. It chases the Pleiades across the sky and never catches them.
A giant striding across the winter sky. Its belt of three stars points the way east and west.
The swooping eagle - a summer star, high overhead in the evening.
The flying eagle, with a star on each wing.
Two bright stars of spring. Caravans heading south-west once steered by them.
